name: practice_set1
description: 1. Install `nodemon` and `express`. 2. Add two dummy middleware functions:    - one that logs the request path    - one that logs the request method 3. Add a third middleware that returns a response. 4. Add route handling using two more middleware functions:    - one for the path `/`    - one for the path `/contact-us` 5. Make `/contact-us` return a form with `name` and `email` input fields.    - the form should submit back to the `/contact-us` page 6. Also handle `POST` requests to `/contact-us` using a separate middleware.
